description: This Java class defines a filter for logging output that passes through only the message part, excluding metadata like tags or priorities. It implements the LogNode interface and is used to create a chain of log processing nodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements LogNode, passing only log messages downstream without additional metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes the log message and forwards only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for the chain.
